notes: Insurance is one of three segments alongside funeral services and mortgage lending; the website gives no insurance financial ratios or solvency data.

insurance_business_line.value: Life insurance focused on end-of-life products (preneed, final expense), within a group that also runs funeral and mortgage segments

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Direct primary life insurer; products sold with support from affiliated mortuary and cemetery operations, growing through acquisitions of life insurers

premium_exposure_mix.value: End-of-life products, including preneed funeral and cemetery insurance, led the insurance business

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Life insurer; combined ratio is a property-casualty measure

liability_duration_guarantees_life_and_a.value: Long-duration life and final-expense liabilities, plus annuities, from end-of-life insurance products

investment_liability_matching.value: Insurance assets invested largely in high-quality mortgage loans, with conservative investment principles
